title: Yamaha ERROR 17 - Internal DSP Error
fullDescription:
Yamaha ERROR 17 indicates a failure in the digital signal processor (DSP) during initialization or playback.

This can be caused by corrupted firmware, unstable power, or a genuine DSP fault.

Power cycle and firmware refresh should be attempted before service.

fixSteps.title: Reapply firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Reinstall latest firmware via MusicCast app or USB.

whenToCallPro: If error repeats after firmware reflash.

faq.a: Not always; firmware refresh often clears it.

title: Yamaha ERROR 29 - Network Error
fullDescription:
ERROR 29 is shown when the Yamaha soundbar cannot reach MusicCast or streaming services over the network.

Restart the router and soundbar, and verify network access.

title: Yamaha ERROR 31 - HDMI Handshake Failure
shortDescription: HDMI handshake with TV or source failed.
fullDescription:
ERROR 31 shows when HDMI handshake fails. Could be due to HDCP incompatibility, cable, or TV CEC settings.

Try a different cable and different HDMI port.

fixSteps.title: Reseat cables
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect all HDMI and reconnect firmly.

title: Yamaha ERROR 33 - Amplifier Protection
fullDescription:
ERROR 33 indicates the amplifier circuit has shut down to protect itself. Caused by short-circuited speaker wires, overheating, or excessive volume.

Let the unit cool and check wiring.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and let the unit cool for 30 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Check for loose speaker strands touching.

faq.a: Within rated spec yes; sustained max can trigger protection.

title: Yamaha Soundbar WiFi Error
fullDescription: WiFi setup or reconnection fails. Typically due to password, band, or security incompatibility.

fixSteps.title: Retry with WPS
fixSteps.instruction: Use router WPS button plus soundbar WPS.

title: Yamaha Chromecast built-in Error
shortDescription: Chromecast casting to the soundbar fails.
fullDescription: Chromecast built-in relies on mDNS discovery and Google services. Errors can occur when the phone and soundbar are on different VLANs or when Google services have outages.

fixSteps.title: Same network
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure phone and soundbar share the same SSID/VLAN.

fixSteps.title: Reboot Google Home
fixSteps.instruction: Restart Google Home app and soundbar.

title: Yamaha MusicCast Error
fullDescription: MusicCast links multiple Yamaha speakers for multi-room audio. Errors result when firmware mismatches between MusicCast devices or when the router blocks UPnP/SSDP.

fixSteps.title: Update all speakers
fixSteps.instruction: Use MusicCast app to update each speaker.

faq.a: Only those running v3.x or newer firmware.

title: Yamaha HDMI Zone B Error
fullDescription: Zone B on supported Yamaha AV soundbars routes secondary audio to a separate room. Errors happen when Zone B is disabled, source isn't assigned, or the output port is misconfigured.

fixSteps.title: Enable Zone B
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > Zone B > On, assign source input.

affectedModels: Yamaha RX-V series combined with soundbar usage

faq.a: Yes, that's the point of Zone B.

title: Yamaha Soundbar No Signal
shortDescription: Soundbar displays no signal from selected input.
fullDescription: The soundbar detects the cable but no audio stream is coming through. Check TV audio output settings (PCM/Bitstream), source activation, and cable integrity.

fixSteps.title: Enable TV audio out
fixSteps.instruction: Set TV audio output to External/Soundbar.

title: Yamaha Speaker Impedance Error
shortDescription: Impedance mismatch detected between soundbar and external speakers.
fullDescription:
For Yamaha soundbars supporting external passive speakers, an impedance mismatch can trigger an error. Use 6-ohm or higher speakers unless the unit explicitly supports lower impedance.

Verify wiring and speaker spec before reconnecting.

fixSteps.title: Set impedance switch
fixSteps.instruction: If amp has a 4-6-8 ohm switch, set to matching value.

whenToCallPro: If speaker wires may be shorting.

faq.a: Only if amp is rated for it.
